table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	MCNo = P.RegNo,
	PatientName = P.Name,
	Age = P.AgeYears,
	Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = SH.CustCode),
	Doctor=D.Name,
	Test = S.Name,
	VisitDate=SH.Date,
	TokenNo=SH.TokenNo,
	Fee = SUM(SD.Qty * SD.Price),
	Discount = SUM(
		(SD.Qty * SD.ServiceFlatDisc) + 
		(SD.Qty * (SD.Price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
		(SD.Qty * (SD.Price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (SH.DiscPerc * 0.01))),
	Received = SUM(
		(SD.Qty * (SD.Price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SH.DiscPerc * 0.01))),
	UserName = U.UserName,
	ShareAmt = SUM(SD.Qty * SD.Commission) + 
		SUM(	SD.Qty * (SD.Price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SH.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.SharePerc * 0.01)
FROM ServiceHeader SH, ServiceDetail SD, Doctors D, Service S, Patient P, Users U
WHERE 
	SH.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	SH.ServiceInvCode = SD.ServiceInvCode AND
	SH.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	SH.SalesManCode = U.UserCode AND
	P.DoctCode = D.DoctCode AND
	D.DoctCode IN (:ai_doctcode) AND
	SD.ServiceCode=S.ServiceCode
GROUP BY
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	P.AgeYears,
	D.Name,
	S.Name,
	SH.Date,
	SH.CustCode,
	SH.TokenNo,
	U.UserName
table.sort: doctor A, customer A, patientname A

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: 'Dr. Share:' +  STRING((SUM(shareamt for all) / if(SUM( received for all) > 0, SUM( received for all),1)) * 100, '##,##0.00') + SPACE(5) + 'Hsp. Share:' +  STRING((SUM(received - shareamt for all) / if(SUM( received for all) > 0, SUM( received for all),1)) * 100,'##,##0.00')

objects.name: compute_16
objects.expression: 'Dr. Share:' +  TRIM(STRING((SUM(shareamt for group 1) / if(SUM( received for group 1) > 0, SUM( received for group 1),1)) * 100, '##,##0.00')) + '%' + SPACE(5) + 'Hsp. Share:' +  TRIM(STRING((SUM(received - shareamt for group 1) / if(SUM( received for group 1) > 0, SUM( received for group 1),1)) * 100,'##,##0.00')) + '%'
